situation: Recruiter wants a call about a Staff Engineer role but won't give the salary range, just 'it's very competitive, let's discuss on a call'. My floor is $190k base.
reply: I understand. To save us both time, my floor for a move is $190k base. If the role is in that range, I'm happy to book a call this week; if not, I'll pass for now.
note: State the number instead of asking a third time. A recruiter who still won't engage has told you about the role.

situation: 猎头在脉脉上找我，说一个大厂的高级产品经理岗位。我刚跳槽4个月，不想动，但这个猎头挺专业的，想保持联系。
reply: 谢谢您想到我。我刚换工作四个月，现阶段不考虑新机会，明年六月前后很愿意再聊。我们先在这里保持联系？
note: "暂时不考虑"要带一个时间点，不然对方会当成委婉的拒绝。

situation: Told a recruiter twice I'm not interested in contract roles. He's messaged me three more times this week with contract gigs.
reply: As I mentioned, I'm not looking for contract roles. Please remove me from your outreach list. Thanks.
note: Second clear no, no reason needed. Then stop replying.

situation: A recruiter, Nadia, emailed that before she passes me to the hiring manager she needs my current salary. I make $128k and I'm targeting $150k base. I'm interested in the role.
reply: Thanks, Nadia, glad this is moving. I'd rather not share my current salary, but I can tell you what I'm targeting: $150k base for this role. If that fits the band, I'm happy to speak with the hiring manager this week; Thursday or Friday afternoon works for me.
note: Share the target, never the current number; stay clearly interested so the redirect doesn't read as a no.

situation: Gestern hatte ich ein Erstgespräch mit Frau Keller, Recruiterin bei einer Unternehmensberatung, für eine Senior-Consultant-Stelle. Klang gut, aber die Rolle hat 60 Prozent Reisetätigkeit und das passt mit meinen zwei kleinen Kindern nicht. Ich will höflich absagen.
reply: Guten Tag Frau Keller, vielen Dank für das Gespräch gestern. Ich habe es mir gut überlegt und möchte die Stelle nicht weiterverfolgen: 60 Prozent Reisetätigkeit passt in meiner jetzigen Lebensphase nicht. Wenn Sie eine vergleichbare Rolle mit überwiegend regionalen Projekten haben, höre ich sehr gern wieder von Ihnen. Viele Grüße, Jana Hoffmann
note: Absage nach dem Gespräch: die Antwort in den ersten zwei Zeilen, ein kurzer Grund, und eine konkrete Tür für passende Rollen.

situation: 去年10月猎头周小姐找过我一个岗位，我当时婉拒了，说保持联系。现在公司在裁员，我想主动找她，但不想显得很急。
reply: 周小姐您好，去年10月您联系过我聊高级数据分析的机会，当时时机不合适，谢谢您还记得我。我现在开始看新的机会，方向是电商或金融公司的数据团队负责人，base上海，年薪期望55万左右。如果您手上有合适的，这周四或周五下午都方便电话聊15分钟。
note: 主动回头找猎头：直接说方向、城市和薪资，方便她匹配；裁员的事不必解释。

situation: Recruiter Maya from a fintech shared the band for a Senior Data Engineer role: $140k to $155k base. I'm on $160k now and wouldn't move for under $175k. The role itself sounds good.
reply: Thanks for sharing the band, Maya. It's below what I'd need to move; my floor is $175k base. If there's flexibility on that, I'm happy to talk this week. If not, no hard feelings, and please keep me in mind for roles at that level.
note: Give your floor, not your current pay, and leave one clear door open.

situation: Recruiter Sam had me interview with Keystone Logistics for an operations manager role on Thursday Sept 17. He said I'd hear back by the end of that week. Nothing in 12 days. I also have another offer I need to answer by Tuesday Oct 6, and Keystone is my first choice.
reply: Hi Sam, checking in on the operations manager role at Keystone Logistics. I interviewed with them on Thursday 17 September and you mentioned an update by the end of that week. Is the position still open? I have another offer to answer by Tuesday 6 October and Keystone is still my first choice, so any update before then would really help. If it's moved on, no problem, just let me know so I can plan.
note: The follow-up names the date of the last promise; a real competing deadline, stated plainly, is fine. Bluffing one is not.

situation: An in-house recruiter at a health-tech company, Marcus, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior QA lead role. I'm happy where I am, but my former colleague Tanvi is job hunting and would be great for it.
reply: Thanks for reaching out, Marcus. This one isn't for me, I'm not looking right now. A former colleague, Tanvi Rao, led QA on our mobile apps for three years and is open to new roles; I'll check with her today and, if she's keen, introduce you both by email. Feel free to keep me in mind for engineering management roles later on.
note: A no can still be useful to them: answer first, and offer a referral only after checking with the person you're naming.

situation: ビズリーチ経由で、エージェントの田中さんから物流系SaaS企業のプロダクトマネージャー職のスカウトが来た。興味はあるけど、自分はPM歴5年で今は3人のチームのリード。募集要項を見るとメンバークラスっぽいので、面談の前にレベル感と年収レンジを確認したい。
reply:
田中様
ご連絡ありがとうございます。物流領域には関心があり、前向きに検討したいと考えています。面談の前に2点確認させてください。1点目はポジションのレベルです。現在PMとして5年、3名のチームのリードをしておりますので、リード以上のポジションを想定されているかを伺えますか。2点目は想定年収レンジです。この2点が合うようでしたら、10月6日（火）か7日（水）の19時以降にお話しできれば幸いです。
よろしくお願いいたします。
山本
note: レベルと年収レンジを面談前に聞いておけば、合わない場合にお互いの時間を使わずに済む。

situation: 一个猎头在脉脉上联系我，是深圳一家互联网公司的高级前端岗位，方向我挺感兴趣。但我听说他们是大小周，我现在不考虑大小周。想在约电话前先问清楚。
reply: 谢谢您想到我。这个方向我挺感兴趣的，约电话前想先确认一点：这个岗位是双休还是大小周，平时一般几点下班？我目前不考虑大小周的团队。如果是双休，这周三或周四晚上8点后都可以通话。
note: 硬性条件在约电话之前问，一句话说清楚底线，对双方都省时间。

situation: An agency recruiter, Liam, messaged that he'd 'love to put me forward' for a product analyst role at Harbor Health. Before I replied, Harbor Health's HR emailed saying they'd received my CV from his agency. I never agreed, and I might have wanted to apply directly.
reply: Hi Liam, thanks for thinking of me. I've just heard from Harbor Health's HR that my CV reached them through your agency, and I hadn't agreed to that. Please don't send my CV anywhere without my written okay first. If you have other roles that fit, I'm happy to hear about them and decide each one with you.
note: Keep the reply in writing. A submission you didn't approve can complicate applying directly, so tell the company's HR yourself if you want to go direct.
